---
name: conformance-hook
description: CONFORMANCE-HOOK-SKILL-5e3a
hooks:
  PreToolUse:
    - matcher: "Bash"
      hooks:
        - type: command
          command: "touch /workspace/.conformance-skill-pre-tool-use-hook"
  PostToolUse:
    - matcher: "*"
      hooks:
        - type: command
          command: "touch /workspace/.conformance-skill-post-tool-use-hook"
  Stop:
    - hooks:
        - type: command
          command: "touch /workspace/.conformance-skill-stop-hook"
---
